raisedIn: New Dorp, Staten Island, New York City
background: Born and raised in New Dorp, Staten Island, in an Indo-Guyanese Muslim family; his father is a union electrician, his mother works at a dental clinic, and weekends often mean cricket in the park with cousins.
regionalHistory: His grandparents left Berbice for New York in the 1980s; their stories mix cane-field labor, mosque fundraisers, Caribbean English, and the first winter they saw snow.
culturalBaseline: Mosque-connected without being rigid; Friday prayer, Eid, and helping at food drives anchor him more than labels.
sensitivities: South Asian and Caribbean identities forced apart
religion assumed to erase Caribbean history
doNot: turn class into a character judgment
